tasks.question: What is the name of the department with the student that has the lowest GPA?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T2.dept_name FROM student AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_code  =  T2.dept_code ORDER BY stu_gpa LIMIT 1

tasks.question: Find the names and average salaries of all departments whose average salary is greater than 42000.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT dept_name ,  AVG (salary) FROM instructor GROUP BY dept_name HAVING AVG (salary)  >  42000

tasks.question: Find names of instructors with salary greater than that of some (at least one) instructor in the Biology department.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT name FROM instructor WHERE salary  >  (SELECT min(salary) FROM instructor WHERE dept_name  =  'Biology')

tasks.question: What are the building, room number, semester and year of courses in the Psychology department, sorted using course title?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T2.building ,  T2.room_number ,  T2.semester ,  T2.year FROM course AS T1 JOIN SECTION AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id WHERE T1.dept_name  =  'Psychology' ORDER BY T1.title

tasks.question: Find courses that ran in Fall 2009 but not in Spring 2010.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE semester  =  'Fall' AND YEAR  =  2009 EXCEPT SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE semester  =  'Spring' AND YEAR  =  2010

tasks.question: What are the names and genders of staff who have held the title Sales Person, but never Clerical Staff?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.staff_name ,  T1.staff_gender FROM staff AS T1 JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments AS T2 ON T1.staff_id  =  T2.staff_id WHERE T2.job_title_code  =  "Sales Person" EXCEPT SELECT T1.staff_name ,  T1.staff_gender FROM staff AS T1 JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments AS T2 ON T1.staff_id  =  T2.staff_id WHERE T2.job_title_code  =  "Clerical Staff"

tasks.question: Which city does staff with first name as Janessa and last name as Sawayn live?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.city FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Staff AS T2 ON T1.address_id = T2.staff_address_id WHERE T2.first_name = "Janessa" AND T2.last_name = "Sawayn";

tasks.question: Find the distinct driver id of all drivers that have a longer stop duration than some drivers in the race whose id is 841?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT driverid ,  STOP FROM pitstops WHERE duration  >  (SELECT min(duration) FROM pitstops WHERE raceid  =  841)

tasks.question: What are all the different first names of the drivers who are in position as standing and won?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.forename FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN driverstandings AS T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid WHERE T2.position = 1 AND T2.wins = 1

tasks.question: What are all details of the students who registered but did not attend any course?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT * FROM student_course_registrations WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM student_course_attendance)

tasks.question: What is the id of the candidate whose email is stanley.monahan@example.org?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T2.candidate_id FROM people AS T1 JOIN candidates AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.candidate_id WHERE T1.email_address = "stanley.monahan@example.org"

tasks.question: What are the task details, task ids, and project ids for the progrects that are detailed as 'omnis' or have at least 3 outcomes?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.task_details ,  T1.task_id ,  T2.project_id FROM Tasks AS T1 JOIN Projects AS T2 ON T1.project_id  =  T2.project_id WHERE T2.project_details  =  'omnis' UNION SELECT T1.task_details ,  T1.task_id ,  T2.project_id FROM Tasks AS T1 JOIN Projects AS T2 ON T1.project_id  =  T2.project_id JOIN Project_outcomes AS T3 ON T2.project_id  =  T3.project_id GROUP BY T2.project_id HAVING count(*)  >  2

tasks.question: What are the details of the project with no outcomes?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT project_details FROM Projects WHERE project_id NOT IN ( SELECT project_id FROM Project_outcomes )

tasks.question: What is the count and code of the job with the most employee?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT emp_jobcode ,  count(*) FROM employee GROUP BY emp_jobcode ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.question: What are the names and average salaries for departments with average salary higher than 42000?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT dept_name ,  AVG (salary) FROM instructor GROUP BY dept_name HAVING AVG (salary)  >  42000
